nom: ANUA Niacinamide 10 TXA 4 Serum for Brightening and Dark Spots

segments.oily: Oily and combo-oily reviewers report the serum reduces shine and pore appearance for some, while others describe it leaving skin looking oily or greasy after application.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or combination-dry skin describe it as hydrating, smooth, and non-sticky, with slow but visible fading of dark spots.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers (oily T-zone, dry cheeks) generally report good tolerance and gradual brightening, with one noting no irritation but little change in dark spots.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several say it is gentle, hydrating and non-irritating, while others report immediate burning, closed comedones, or a damaged skin barrier requiring the product to be washed off.
segments.mature: One reviewer with an age spot and crow's feet reports visible lightening of the spot after two weeks, with no other mature-specific feedback in the reviews.

concerns.aging: A single mature-skin reviewer reports lightening of an age spot and improved look of crow's feet after two weeks of use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention hydration describe the serum as hydrating, smooth and bouncy; one reviewer noted persistent slight dryness/unhydrated feeling even under moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Reviewers targeting redness report it fading gradually over one to two months, with one describing complete disappearance of stubborn red patches; texture and tone-evening effects are mentioned alongside this.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the serum damaged her skin barrier with burning and closed comedones after only two uses; most other reviewers do not report barrier issues.
concerns.spots: The large majority of reviewers targeting dark spots, hyperpigmentation, melasma, sunspots or postpartum pigmentation report visible fading within one to several weeks; a minority (2-3 reviewers) say they saw no major change after months of use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers using it for acne scars and acne marks mostly report fading, sometimes within days; a few describe new breakouts, cystic pimples, or surface acne appearing after use.
concerns.oiliness: Some reviewers say it reduces oiliness and shrinks the appearance of pores, while others say it makes skin look oily or greasy, especially with sensitive or acne-prone skin.

extraits.texte: I bought this product thinking it will help with discoloration on my skin but it destroyed my skin barrier after two uses. It made my cheeks burn, and i ended up with closed comedones all over my forehead and cheeks. The percentage of niacinamide in this is 10% . If your skin cant handle niacinamide at a high percentage or at all, then this isnt for you. If you have sensitive or reactive skin, then it isnt for you.

If you have FUNGAL acne i wouldnt use this as there are a few ingredients that are known to cause clogged pores or cysts to appear (fungal acne only). If you have hormonal ance then youre fine (i have this). It is a nice serum, it can sometimes leave your soim feeling a bit sticky (espically if used woth other products such as a toner) so i would only use this at night, espically since it has Niacinamide which can make your skin sensitive to the sun (more likely to burn). However, niacinamide isnt a bad thing as it helps reduce redness, minimize acne/oil, and helps "brighten" (fade) dark spots (such as acne scars). Can leave tour face looking a bit oily so another reason to use at night. Also, wouldn't recommend mixing this product with anything like hyluranic acid (or however you spell it) as 10% niacinamide and the txa is already a little harsh sometimes and moxing it with other active ingredients can do more harm than good. Ive used this product before and it has faded any irritaion and acne scars (with time), it didnt happen right away but after 2 weeks of use (every night) i saw scars getting noticeably lighter. Overall, is a pretty good product that i recommend. I have eczema, dry and oily skin, am acne prone, and have hormonal acne and have never had a problem with this product.

I have a love-hate with this product. It has a really high concentration of important skin care ingredients, and in combo with my entire skin care regime- my skin seriously looks great. But…. It's soooooooo sticky! It's goopy, and it takes forever to absorb! Even at small amounts. I have to build in at least 15 minutes extra for it to sink in enough to put moisturizer on top and its still sticky. Its ironic its advertised as lightweight and not sticky- I'm on my 3rd bottle and I curse the stickiness every day. So beware, and have patience.

extraits.titre: I really like it so far!
extraits.texte: Someone at Ulta recommended this to me. I really like it so far. I have combination skin - very oily in my T zone and dry around my mouth/cheeks. This didn't irritate my sensitive skin and didn't make me oily which is what I find more serums do for me. I've been using it everyday. Haven't noticed a big difference in my dark spots but so far so good with everything else.

I have seen bad reviews on this and i dont get it! I have very sensitive skin and this is a game changer for my makeup!!! It looks like ice on my skin! It hydrates beautifully and is priced well! I love it!!

extraits.titre: Had no idea when I bought it, but wow!
extraits.texte: I added this trial size while in line, to fulfill the remainder of a coupon i was using. Ive never used this brand before so I didn't have high expectations when comparing similar ingredients in products from other lines that ive usec . I recently started trying 2 popular korean brands from tick tock. Medi destroyed my akin, which i have been working on for weeks to repair. DrM actually worked pretty well for me, but still didn't deliver what I had hoped for. I think it's just too many steps for my skin, As it's recently become sensitive. The first day I used this product it layered very well with my moisturizer underneath my foundation. (I will state, even if you use toner, id apply it after this product.) Normally my makeup routine products pilled by the end of my 12 hour shift, but not with this one! The second and third day I noticed a minor bit of dryness around my nose and chin, but nothing unbearable. After the fourth day, my skin started looking better than it has in months. My dark spots are fading, mind you I never had any acne scars until the past year or so. My skin is smoother and I am extremely happy with this product. I am so glad that I asked the cashier if it was a popular brand before I bought it. I'm now purchasing the larger bottle and probably switching it from my previous routine due to it delivering the best results so far. extraits.titre: I never imagined I'd see my skin without redness again—until
extraits.texte: After countless hours of searching and researching, I learned that niacinamide could help reduce facial redness. That's when I discovered this brand on YouTube and decided to give it a try. From the very first week, I noticed the difference. By the end of the first month, most of my redness had faded. And after two months, even the stubborn red patches I thought would never go away had completely disappeared. The transformation has been nothing short of life-changing. I'm now on my second bottle and know this will forever be a staple in my routine. For context, I use it alongside a moisturizer and The Ordinary's GF 15 solution, which complement it perfectly. But the star of my routine is undeniably this product. Thank you for creating something that doesn't just promise results, but truly delivers.
